requirements_summary: Must support 500-1,000 QPS peak for embedding lookups (semantic search) with p95 query latency <200ms for online queries. Nightly batch jobs: embed 2M documents/day with retry/resume, integrated with existing Airflow pipeline. Pricing sensitivity: target embedding cost <$0.0008/token equivalent or < $0.02 per 1,000 embeddings (goal).
